coverage: AUTH-03 observes session revocation across a new adapter connected to the same persistent store.
AUTH-04 covers provider access_denied, browser close, late callback, and no code exchange after denial.
CAPACITY-01 tests the configured pending-pair upper bound without inventing terminal cleanup rules.

CAPACITY-02 separates first initialization and recovery_replace; both cover exact 16 KiB acceptance while over-limit replace preserves prior state. Initial setup follows 03 §5.1/§9: the personal workspace and pending device already exist; an over-limit initialization leaves the workspace uninitialized, does not persist the recovery package, and does not activate the device. Capacity limits are sourced from limits.v1.json and interpreted per 03 §11.
CAPACITY-03/04 separate expiry replay and account switch; B cannot consume A's pair and the undefined persisted terminal-state mapping is left open.
KEY-01 scopes credential storage checks to device/recovery fields and checks SHA-256(deviceCredential) without constraining Better Auth's own session/password store.

limitations: The specification does not define the persisted status mapping or immediate pending-slot release behavior after account-switch cancellation; these remain OPEN QUESTION rather than invented fixture expectations.
All T14 behavior remains unexecuted. Real OAuth provider behavior, isolated PostgreSQL RLS, cross-tenant acceptance, and adversarial acceptance review remain NOT_RUN.
